proves.claim: with review.relaxRequiredFamily on and a relaxation witness for the seat, the requiredReviewFamily guard of reviewerChecks returns no refusal for a seat of another family.

store.io-board-review-family-relax-requi.why: Without this case the required-family guard could keep refusing a witnessed seat and next --verify would never offer the widened review.

proves.claim: with the setting off, with no relaxationFor, and for a seat of the builder session, the requiredReviewFamily guard of reviewerChecks still returns the REQUIRED_REVIEW_FAMILY refusal.

store.io-board-review-family-relax-requi.why: Without this case the guard could stand down with the setting off or without a witness and a seat of the wrong family could review.
